verses.original: אַף־ לְ֭זֹאת יֶחֱרַ֣ד לִבִּ֑י וְ֝יִתַּ֗ר מִמְּקוֹמֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ap̄- lə·zōṯ ye·ḥĕ·raḏ lib·bî wə·yit·tar mim·mə·qō·w·mōw
verses.literal: At this my heart also pounds and leaps from its place
verses.literalPt: Sobre isso treme também o meu coração, salta do seu lugar.

verses.original: שִׁמְע֤וּ שָׁמ֣וֹעַ בְּרֹ֣גֶז קֹל֑וֹ וְ֝הֶ֗גֶה מִפִּ֥יו יֵצֵֽא׃
verses.transliteration: šim·‘ū šā·mō·w·a‘ bə·rō·ḡez qō·lōw wə·he·ḡeh mip·pîw yê·ṣê
verses.literal: Listen closely . . . to the thunder of His voice and the rumbling that comes from His mouth
verses.literalPt: Dai ouvidos ao estrondo da voz de Deus e ao sonido que sai da sua boca.

verses.original: תַּֽחַת־ כָּל־ הַשָּׁמַ֥יִם יִשְׁרֵ֑הוּ וְ֝אוֹר֗וֹ עַל־ כַּנְפ֥וֹת הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: ta·ḥaṯ- kāl- haš·šā·ma·yim yiš·rê·hū wə·’ō·w·rōw ‘al- kan·p̄ō·wṯ hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: He unleashes His lightning beneath the whole sky and sends it to the ends of the earth
verses.literalPt: Ele o envia por sob a extensão do céu e o seu relâmpago, até as extremidades da terra.

verses.original: אַחֲרָ֤יו׀ יִשְׁאַג־ ק֗וֹל יַ֭רְעֵם בְּק֣וֹל גְּאוֹנ֑וֹ וְלֹ֥א יְ֝עַקְּבֵ֗ם כִּֽי־ יִשָּׁמַ֥ע קוֹלֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’a·ḥă·rāw yiš·’aḡ- qō·wl yar·‘êm bə·qō·wl gə·’ō·w·nōw wə·lō yə·‘aq·qə·ḇêm kî- yiš·šā·ma‘ qō·w·lōw
verses.literal: Then there comes a roaring sound He thunders with His majestic voice He does not restrain the lightning when His voice resounds
verses.literalPt: Depois, ruge uma voz; troveja com a sua voz majestosa; não retarda os raios, quando a sua voz é ouvida.

verses.original: יַרְעֵ֤ם אֵ֣ל בְּ֭קוֹלוֹ נִפְלָא֑וֹת עֹשֶׂ֥ה גְ֝דֹל֗וֹת וְלֹ֣א נֵדָֽע׃
verses.transliteration: yar·‘êm ’êl bə·qō·w·lōw nip̄·lā·’ō·wṯ ‘ō·śeh ḡə·ḏō·lō·wṯ wə·lō nê·ḏā‘
verses.literal: God thunders wondrously with His voice He does great things we cannot comprehend
verses.literalPt: Troveja Deus maravilhosamente com a sua voz, faz grandes coisas que não podemos compreender.

verses.original: כִּ֤י לַשֶּׁ֨לַג׀ יֹאמַ֗ר הֱוֵ֫א אָ֥רֶץ וְגֶ֥שֶׁם מָטָ֑ר וְ֝גֶ֗שֶׁם מִטְר֥וֹת עֻזּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kî laš·šɛ·laḡ yō·mar hĕ·wê ’ā·reṣ wə·ḡe·šem mā·ṭār wə·ḡe·šem miṭ·rō·wṯ ‘uz·zōw
verses.literal: For He says to the snow Fall on the earth and to the gentle rain . . . Pour out a mighty downpour
verses.literalPt: Pois diz à neve: Cai sobre a terra; di-lo também às chuvas, até as chuvas mais fortes.

verses.original: בְּיַד־ כָּל־ אָדָ֥ם יַחְתּ֑וֹם לָ֝דַ֗עַת כָּל־ אַנְשֵׁ֥י מַעֲשֵֽׂהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: bə·yaḏ- kāl- ’ā·ḏām yaḥ·tō·wm lā·ḏa·‘aṯ kāl- ’an·šê ma·‘ă·śê·hū
verses.literal: He seals up the hand of every man so that all men may know His work
verses.literalPt: Põe um selo à mão de cada homem, para que o conheçam todos os homens que fez.

verses.original: וַתָּבֹ֣א חַיָּ֣ה בְמוֹ־ אָ֑רֶב וּבִמְע֖וֹנֹתֶ֣יהָ תִשְׁכֹּֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tā·ḇō ḥay·yāh ḇə·mōw- ’ā·reḇ ū·ḇim·‘ō·w·nō·ṯe·hā ṯiš·kōn
verses.literal: The wild animals . . . enter their lairs they settle down in their dens
verses.literalPt: Então, as feras entram nos esconderijos e ficam nos seus covis.

verses.original: מִן־ הַ֭חֶדֶר תָּב֣וֹא סוּפָ֑ה וּֽמִמְּזָרִ֥ים קָרָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: min- ha·ḥe·ḏer tā·ḇō·w sū·p̄āh ū·mim·mə·zā·rîm qā·rāh
verses.literal: The tempest comes from its chamber and the cold from the driving north winds
verses.literalPt: Da câmara do Sul sai o tufão, e, do Norte, o frio.

verses.original: מִנִּשְׁמַת־ אֵ֥ל יִתֶּן־ קָ֑רַח וְרֹ֖חַב מַ֣יִם בְּמוּצָֽק׃
verses.transliteration: min·niš·maṯ- ’êl yit·ten- qā·raḥ wə·rō·ḥaḇ ma·yim bə·mū·ṣāq
verses.literal: By the breath of God the ice is formed and the watery expanses are frozen
verses.literalPt: Ao sopro de Deus, forma-se o gelo, e as amplas águas são congeladas.

verses.original: אַף־ בְּ֭רִי יַטְרִ֣יחַ עָ֑ב יָ֝פִ֗יץ עֲנַ֣ן אוֹרֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ap̄- bə·rî yaṭ·rî·aḥ ‘āḇ yā·p̄îṣ ‘ă·nan ’ō·w·rōw
verses.literal: He loads the clouds with moisture He scatters His lightning through them
verses.literalPt: Carrega de umidade a densa nuvem e estende a sua nuvem de relâmpagos,

verses.original: וְה֤וּא מְסִבּ֨וֹת׀ מִתְהַפֵּ֣ךְ בְּתַחְבּוּלָתוֹ לְפָעֳלָ֑ם כֹּ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְצַוֵּ֓ם׀ עַל־ פְּנֵ֖י תֵבֵ֣ל אָֽרְצָה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hū mə·sib·bō·wṯ miṯ·hap·pêḵ bə·ṯaḥ·bū·lå̄·ṯō lə·p̄ā·‘o·lām kōl ’ă·šer yə·ṣaw·wêm ‘al- pə·nê ṯê·ḇêl ’ā·rə·ṣāh
verses.literal: They swirl about whirling at His direction accomplishing all that He commands over the face of all the earth
verses.literalPt: que faz evoluções sobre a sua direção, para efetuar tudo o que lhe ordena sobre a superfície do mundo habitável:

verses.original: אִם־ לְשֵׁ֥בֶט אִם־ לְאַרְצ֑וֹ אִם־ לְ֝חֶ֗סֶד יַמְצִאֵֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- lə·šê·ḇeṭ ’im- lə·’ar·ṣōw ’im- lə·ḥe·seḏ yam·ṣi·’ê·hū
verses.literal: Whether for punishment or for His land . . . He accomplishes this in His loving devotion
verses.literalPt: ou seja, para a correção (ou seja, para sua terra) ou para misericórdia, que ele a faça vir.

verses.original: הַאֲזִ֣ינָה זֹּ֣את אִיּ֑וֹב עֲ֝מֹ֗ד וְהִתְבּוֹנֵ֤ן׀ נִפְלְא֬וֹת אֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: ha·’ă·zî·nāh zōṯ ’î·yō·wḇ ‘ă·mōḏ wə·hiṯ·bō·w·nên nip̄·lə·’ō·wṯ ’êl
verses.literal: Listen to this O Job stand still and consider the wonders of God
verses.literalPt: Inclina, Jó, os teus ouvidos a isso; para e considera as maravilhas de Deus.

verses.original: הֲ֭תֵדַע בְּשׂוּם־ אֱל֣וֹהַּ עֲלֵיהֶ֑ם וְ֝הוֹפִ֗יעַ א֣וֹר עֲנָנֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: hă·ṯê·ḏa‘ bə·śūm- ’ĕ·lō·w·ah ‘ă·lê·hem wə·hō·w·p̄î·a‘ ’ō·wr ‘ă·nā·nōw
verses.literal: Do you know how God . . . dispatches the clouds or makes the lightning flash
verses.literalPt: Acaso, sabes como Deus lhes dá as suas ordens e faz brilhar o relâmpago da sua nuvem?

verses.original: הֲ֭תֵדַע עַל־ מִפְלְשֵׂי־ עָ֑ב מִ֝פְלְא֗וֹת תְּמִ֣ים דֵּעִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: hă·ṯê·ḏa‘ ‘al- mip̄·lə·śê- ‘āḇ mip̄·lə·’ō·wṯ tə·mîm dê·‘îm
verses.literal: Do you understand how the clouds float those wonders of Him who is perfect in knowledge
verses.literalPt: Porventura, sabes o equilíbrio das nuvens, as maravilhas daquele que é perfeito em conhecimento.

verses.original: אֲשֶׁר־ בְּגָדֶ֥יךָ חַמִּ֑ים בְּהַשְׁקִ֥ט אֶ֝֗רֶץ מִדָּרֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·šer- bə·ḡā·ḏe·ḵā ḥam·mîm bə·haš·qiṭ ’e·reṣ mid·dā·rō·wm
verses.literal: You whose clothes get hot when the land lies hushed under the south wind
verses.literalPt: Tu, cujos vestidos são quentes, quando a terra está quieta por causa do siroco,

verses.original: תַּרְקִ֣יעַ עִ֭מּוֹ לִשְׁחָקִ֑ים חֲ֝זָקִ֗ים כִּרְאִ֥י מוּצָֽק׃
verses.transliteration: tar·qî·a‘ ‘im·mōw liš·ḥā·qîm ḥă·zā·qîm kir·’î mū·ṣāq
verses.literal: can you, like Him spread out the skies as strong as a mirror of bronze
verses.literalPt: acaso, podes, como ele, estender o firmamento, que é sólido como um espelho fundido?

verses.original: ה֭וֹדִיעֵנוּ מַה־ נֹּ֣אמַר ל֑וֹ לֹ֥א־ נַ֝עֲרֹ֗ךְ מִפְּנֵי־ חֹֽשֶׁךְ׃
verses.transliteration: hō·w·ḏî·‘ê·nū mah- nō·mar lōw lō- na·‘ă·rōḵ mip·pə·nê- ḥō·šeḵ
verses.literal: Teach us what we should say to Him we cannot draw up our case because of our darkness
verses.literalPt: Ensina-nos o que lhe diremos, pois, ignorantes, nós não podemos dirigir-lhe a palavra.

verses.original: הַֽיְסֻפַּר־ ל֭וֹ כִּ֣י אֲדַבֵּ֑ר אִֽם־ אָ֥מַר אִ֝֗ישׁ כִּ֣י יְבֻלָּֽע׃
verses.transliteration: hay·sup·par- lōw kî ’ă·ḏab·bêr ’im- ’ā·mar ’îš kî yə·ḇul·lā‘
verses.literal: Should He be told that I want to speak . . . Would a man ask to be swallowed up
verses.literalPt: Ser-lhe-á dito que quero discutir? Desejaria um homem ser aniquilado?

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֤ה׀ לֹ֘א רָ֤אוּ א֗וֹר בָּהִ֣יר ה֭וּא בַּשְּׁחָקִ֑ים וְר֥וּחַ עָ֝בְרָ֗ה וַֽתְּטַהֲרֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh lō rā·’ū ’ō·wr bā·hîr hū baš·šə·ḥā·qîm wə·rū·aḥ ‘ā·ḇə·rāh wat·tə·ṭa·hă·rêm
verses.literal: Now no one can gaze at the sun when it is bright in the skies after the wind has swept them clean
verses.literalPt: Eis que o homem não pode olhar para o sol que brilha no firmamento, quando o vento tem passado e o deixa limpo.

verses.original: מִ֭צָּפוֹן זָהָ֣ב יֶֽאֱתֶ֑ה עַל־ אֱ֝ל֗וֹהַּ נ֣וֹרָא הֽוֹד׃
verses.transliteration: miṣ·ṣā·p̄ō·wn zā·hāḇ ye·’ĕ·ṯeh ‘al- ’ĕ·lō·w·ah nō·w·rā hō·wḏ
verses.literal: Out of the north He comes in golden splendor awesome majesty surrounds Him
verses.literalPt: Do norte vem o áureo esplendor; Deus está cercado de majestade terrível.

verses.original: שַׁדַּ֣י לֹֽא־ מְ֭צָאנֻהוּ שַׂגִּיא־ כֹ֑חַ וּמִשְׁפָּ֥ט וְרֹב־ צְ֝דָקָ֗ה לֹ֣א יְעַנֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: šad·day lō- mə·ṣā·nu·hū śag·gî- ḵō·aḥ ū·miš·pāṭ wə·rōḇ- ṣə·ḏā·qāh lō yə·‘an·neh
verses.literal: The Almighty is beyond our reach He is exalted in power In His justice and great righteousness He does not oppress
verses.literalPt: Quanto ao Todo-Poderoso, não o podemos compreender; grande é em poder. Não perverterá o juízo e a plenitude da justiça.

verses.original: לָ֭כֵן יְרֵא֣וּהוּ אֲנָשִׁ֑ים לֹֽא־ יִ֝רְאֶ֗ה כָּל־ חַכְמֵי־ לֵֽב׃פ
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên yə·rê·’ū·hū ’ă·nā·šîm lō- yir·’eh kāl- ḥaḵ·mê- lêḇ
verses.literal: Therefore men fear Him for He is not partial to the wise in heart
verses.literalPt: Portanto, os homens o temem. Ele não se importa com os que se julgam sábios.
